map.泊松分布概率质量（本页代码口径，对数空间递推防溢出）：ln P(X=0)=−λ，: Poisson probability mass (as coded on this page; recurrence in log space prevents overflow): ln P(X=0)=−λ, then recurse ln P(X=i)=ln P(X=i−1)+ln(λ÷i), P(X=k)=exp(the recurrence up to term k), while accumulating the CDF=P(X≤k); related value: standard deviation=√λ; k is first rounded and capped at 1000. Validation: both fields are mandatory via input guards and must be valid numbers, otherwise a prompt is shown and the calculation stops. Criteria: no fixed grading; with large λ and k, computing λ^k÷k! directly overflows, while the recurrence keeps the numerics stable.
